notes.title: Official Game Release Date Set for October 20th!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that the release date for our game is now set for October 20th! No early access– we are going all in with the full version right from the start. This means you'll have access to over 500,000 words of text, featuring a complete simulation gameplay experience with 22 different endings. As a Roguelike-Simulation Game, we offer an engaging experience with diverse gameplay strategies. You can to select different Oracles to manage your hotel, earn money, and reap the rewards of extraordinary creatures.

We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of you for your patience and support throughout this journey. We hope the game lives up to your expectations and provides you enjoyment.

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey with us, and we look forward to seeing you on October 20th!
